verses.1: It must be done with honesty. It’s not appropriate, after all, to go into the darkness and reveal secrets to the Lord.
verses.2: I know of a man in Christ, who was alive before the age of sixteen. Whether he was in his body or not, whether it was from within his body or not, God knew about him. He was taken away until he reached the third heaven.
verses.3: And I know such a person—whether in his body or outside of his body, I don’t know. But God knew him.
verses.4: For he was taken to heaven, and there he heard harsh words that no human being could utter.
verses.5: I will boast for such a person, but I will not boast for myself unless I am in need.
verses.6: For if I want to boast, I certainly won’t do so without reason. In truth, I will say the truth. I will also try to avoid being seen as someone who claims something based on what they see or hear about me.
verses.7: And also because of the excessive number of revelations. Therefore, so that I would not be overwhelmed, Satan gave me this “scalp” made of flesh, as a means to keep me in check, so that I wouldn’t be overwhelmed.
verses.8: For this reason, I called the Lord three times, asking him to take away me from here.
verses.9: And it was said to me, “Your grace is great. For the power of God ends in weakness.” Therefore, I will boast more in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may be displayed through me.
verses.10: Therefore, I hope in weakness, in sickness, in need, in persecution and hardships, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
verses.11: It happened unexpectedly. You forced me to do this. After all, I had to come together with you. I didn’t do anything more than what was necessary to carry out the orders of those messengers. In fact, I wasn’t even involved in any of this at all.
verses.12: The signs of the apostle’s mission were manifested among you with great patience, through various signs, wonders, and miracles.
verses.13: Why then do you complain about the other churches? Isn’t it because I myself didn’t abandon you? Forgive me for this injustice.
verses.14: I have decided to come to you again, this time with good intentions. I won’t waste your time. After all, it’s not that I want what you have; rather, it’s that parents should not hoard things for their children, but children should not take things from their parents.
verses.15: I will also spend generously and sacrifice for the souls of you. If I love you more, then why should I not love you even more?
verses.16: Let it be then, I have not betrayed you. Instead, I have been deceived by those who were full of deceit.
verses.17: What have I not sent to you? Through him, I have conquered you.
verses.18: I called upon Titus and also joined my brother in this effort. Did Titus really take control of you? Didn’t we be under his influence? Or were we just under their control?
verses.19: Perhaps you think that we are blaming you? But in Christ, we speak to God. And everything else, dear ones, is done for the sake of your house.
verses.20: I fear that when I come, I might not find those who are willing to listen to me. I also fear that you won’t want to hear me. I fear that there will be envy, greed, anger, deceitfulness, hypocrisy, and other negative qualities among you.
verses.21: May the God of me not humiliate me before you again. I will mourn many of those who were deceived and did not repent, and who were subjected to impurity, prostitution, and harm.
